info.title: GetApp Agent Platform API
info.description: RESTful API for GetApp Agent Platform Management

get.description: Retrieves platform metadata including platform ID, name, and type.

put.description: Sets platform identity (ID and type) for this agent.

patch.description: Merges the provided fields into the existing platform metadata. Null values delete the corresponding key.

PlatformEnrollmentSet.description:
Partial platform enrollment data sent via `PUT /platform/enrollment`.
At least one field must be provided; only the supplied fields are updated.

metadata.description:
All stored platform metadata fields (snake_case keys as persisted in `device.meta_data`),
including `platform_name` and `unit`

PlatformMetadataSet.description:
Platform metadata patch sent via `PATCH /platform/metadata`.

The payload is a free-form key-value object with JSON merge-patch semantics: a key set to
`null` deletes the stored field, an absent key is left untouched, and any non-null value
upserts it. Keys map directly to `device.meta_data` storage keys (snake_case). Known keys
are `platform_name` and `location`; arbitrary custom keys are also accepted.

metadata.description: Free-form metadata fields to merge. A `null` value deletes the key.
